breakdown.description: The prompt makes the bending stress uniform through the depth, even though the flexure formula gives a linear stress distribution with zero stress at the neutral axis.
breakdown.reason: The incomplete prompt incorrectly instructed treating the bending stress as uniform over the section depth (same sign at neutral axis as at extreme fibers). The generated specification correctly states that 'The stress distribution is linear: zero at the neutral axis and ±36 MPa at the extreme fibers,' which aligns with the ground truth's proper application of the flexure formula giving a linear stress distribution with zero stress at the neutral axis.
